title: Sanctuary by the Sea #3116 | KEY.co
description_expanded: On this level, you'll find three bedrooms, each with its en suite bathroom. The main bedroom, with access to the covered balcony, features a cable TV and a luxurious bath complete with double vanity, walk-in shower, and jetted tub. The upstairs bedroom is truly extraordinary, boasting panoramic water and nature views through its wall-to-wall doors. The uncovered balcony offers a small dining area and beach chairs, creating a serene retreat. This room also includes a small sofa, a cable TV, and a spacious en suite bathroom with a jetted tub, walk-in shower, and double vanity. The well-equipped kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, boasting modern Viking appliances and ample counter space. The French-door fridge keeps your groceries fresh, while the Viking gas stove/oven simplifies cooking. For coffee lovers, the Keurig machine ensures a quick and energizing start to your day. The dining table offers generous seating, and the adjacent breakfast bar adds additional dining options. Don't forget to indulge in a refreshing smoothie or cocktail from the convenient wet bar with a wine fridge.

Features: Use of charcoal grills is not allowed.
